title: Lipschitz regularity for parabolic fractional $p$-Laplace equations
summary: We prove that local weak solutions to nonlocal parabolic $p$-Laplace equations are locally Lipschitz continuous in space, uniformly in time for every $1 p-1$. Our results hold for symmetric, translation-invariant kernels satisfying standard ellipticity bounds, including kernels that may be discontinuous and require only that the tail of the solution be bounded. In the linear case, our proof provides a different route avoiding blow up arguments and Liouville theorems.
